name: Cencora
description: Cencora (formerly AmerisourceBergen) is one of the three big US drug wholesalers. It buys branded, specialty and generic drugs from manufacturers and delivers them to hospitals, pharmacies, physician practices and clinics, earning about 1.2 percent of revenue as segment operating income on $321.3 billion of FY2025 revenue. Its profit is richer than the revenue suggests: specialty distribution to oncology and retina practices, manufacturer services, and European wholesale (Alliance Healthcare, 24.4 billion in revenue) all earn more per dollar than commodity drug wholesale. Customer concentration is high: Walgreens and Boots together were about 25 percent of FY2025 revenue and Evernorth (Cigna) about 13 percent.

gics.note: Conventional filing: Wikipedia's List of S&P 500 companies (read 2026-09-30) gives sector Health Care and sub-industry Health Care Distributors; industry group and industry not listed there, left null. SEC SIC 5122 (Wholesale-Drugs, Proprietaries & Druggists' Sundries).

hq.note: Per Wikipedia List of S&P 500 companies

employees.note: More than 51,000 employees globally, about 47,000 full-time (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: U.S. Healthcare Solutions
businessLines.how: Buys drugs from manufacturers and resells to pharmacies and providers at a small markup plus fees; specialty drugs for physician practices carry higher markup and service fees, and some practices are owned or co-owned so the company also earns practice income. Revenue is largely pass-through drug cost and moves with drug prices and volume.
businessLines.description: Distribution of brand-name, specialty, generic and over-the-counter drugs, home healthcare supplies and related services to hospitals, health systems, retail and mail-order pharmacies, clinics and long-term care; includes specialty physician practice platforms (retina via Retina Consultants of America, oncology via the OneOncology joint venture), pharma-manufacturer services and animal health.

revenue.note: FY2024 265,339 (+9.7%). Human Health 285,288 (+9.7%); Animal Health 5,695 (+6.1%). 9 months to 2026-06-30 segment revenue $219.8B vs $210.7B (Q3 FY2026 10-Q).

operatingProfit.note: Segment operating income $3,574.7M vs $2,934.9M (+21.8%). Share is of total segment operating income $4,223.0M. Gross profit $7,905M (+23.1%).

businessLines.name: International Healthcare Solutions
businessLines.how: Alliance Healthcare buys from manufacturers and supplies European pharmacies at wholesale margins and provides services; World Courier charges per shipment for temperature-controlled specialty transport; PharmaLex-type businesses bill manufacturers for consulting and regulatory services.
businessLines.description: Alliance Healthcare (European pharmaceutical wholesale and pharmacy services) plus World Courier (specialty transport and logistics) and global commercialization services (PharmaLex and others).

revenue.note: FY2024 28,628 (+6.1%). Alliance Healthcare 24,395 (+5.8%); Other Healthcare Solutions 5,971 (+7.3%).

operatingProfit.note: Segment operating income $648.3M vs $713.4M (-9.1%). Gross profit $3,315M flat (-0.2%).
